text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It seems everyone is here. Bright, Ryan, Palmer, Dober...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? Where are
Ramonu-san and Ardan-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Those two are away. Ramonu-san is overseas, and Ardan-san is recuperating.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Then let us begin.
Toward the upcoming Tenno Sho (Autumn)—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: A Mejiro family conference on how Bright can surpass Suzuka-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The meeting under the blazing sun—heated up,
giving even the summer sunshine a run for its money.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Running alongside her at the Takarazuka Kinen made me realize...
There's just no way to surpass that running style
by doing things normally."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right? Like, is that even an ultra-front-runner strategy?
Is it even considered leading? More like her base speed is just on a whole other level~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I feel like I can't win unless I come up with a more massive running style.
Like a brand new style unique to the Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A new Mejiro running style...
I believe we've finally found our angle.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Let us all think together.
What is 'running in the Mejiro way'?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Let us all say what we believe makes someone "truly Mejiro"
all at the same time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Alright, on three! Ready, go!

text_block_list.name: The Five
text_block_list.text:
"Long distance!" "Explosive runaway lead☆" "Dash power!"
"Guts?" "Umm~..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "A totally carefree answer echoes into the blue sky. Everyone had their own idea of the Mejiro image, and they were completely out of sync..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, are you all even
taking this seriously?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "Hmm, it's hard to sum up what makes someone 'Mejiro-like' in just one word. Everyone has their own individuality, after all."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Even so, there must be a common thread somewhere.
And beyond that—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: There must be a 'running style true to the Mejiro name.' A style of our own that surpasses even Suzuka-san's.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Mee~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright is the one running. I felt we couldn't
make any progress without hearing her thoughts first.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Umm~, the way I see it,
what it truly means to be a Mejiro is~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: If it's Mejiro, then Mejiro it shall be~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Bright...
I mean, you're not wrong, but that doesn't really answer the—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...If they are a Mejiro, then they are a Mejiro.
In other words...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I see, perhaps that is indeed the case.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Unexpectedly, Mejiro Bright's words seemed to spark some kind of inspiration in Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen, what do you mean by "that sort of thing"?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In other words—if you are born a Mejiro, you are a Mejiro;
if you are not, you are not a Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It means there are no other boundaries whatsoever.
Just think about it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Our individual speed, stamina, and running styles—
those are things that can be acquired
as long as one possesses the talent, are they not?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yet the fate, culture, and customs unique to
the Umamusume born into the Mejiro familyâin other wordsâ

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The only thing that cannot be obtained is the "story" called Mejiro.
That story alone, which we have yearned for all this time...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the deep snows of Mount Yotei——
our progenitor descended.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It awakened the 'Mother Mountain,' and from the
benevolence-soaked earth, 'Giants' were born—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before long, all the children began to awaken.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiro Umamusume ran. Swift as the wind.
Across fields, flower gardens, deserts, and snowy plains.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Through racing, she thrilled so many people,
moved their hearts, and spread smiles all around.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Yes, every Mejiro horse girl is someone to look up to. Every one of them... a child of light."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's a story I used to listen to with rapt attention as a kid...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yeees, it's our treasure.
My eyes were sparkling the whole time I listened~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The one I admired so much I couldn't sleep was...
Ramonu-san. The first Triple Tiara winner,
the heroine of the Mejiro family...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The first time we spoke directly, I was trembling so much I couldn't speak.
Even now, whenever I stand on the turf beside her, I feel like crying...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps the people gathered here today
will eventually become just like that, too~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'm sure there will be girls who look up to Lady McQueen's great achievements, and Dober will surely become that kind of Umamusume one day too. And then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The dream... shall continue on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, we have always grown up admiring,
loving, and taking immense pride in the Mejiro name.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That very love is what connects to
the way a Mejiro runs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Putting love into my running... how would I even do that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. Right now...
Could it be, this very meeting—
is precisely that?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan clenched her fists tight—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The reason we're gathered like this right now
isn't just to make Bright win, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
We gathered for Mejiro's sake, refusing to let the Mejiro name be buried by the tides of time.
And then...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To ensure this unbroken chain of admiration never ends,
I won't hesitate to give Bright any support she needs.
We can tackle this as one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Entrusting the family's entire strength to Bright,
uniting their feelings into one "resolve" to charge forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This is the power held exclusively by the Mejiro family.
An immortal bond unlike mere friendship or classmates.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A story continuously handed down since ancient times.
Yes, that is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The story of Mejiro—an interconnected, aspirational tale.
It is precisely because they stand upon the same storyline that they can bring forth its crowning jewel.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you said it before, didn't you?
That Mejiro... That Bright's running
"is fine just the way it is."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Maintaining stamina while sharpening speed, and further polishing her late burst. A pure, all-around enhancement.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps that truly is the way.
However, if we aim for that and everyone begins training Bright from every possible angle—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The strain on her will be immense. Do you truly
believe Bright can endure it and attain
a "new style of Mejiro running"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if deflecting Mejiro McQueen's sharp glare,
I looked over at Mejiro Bright...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A graceful smile rested on her face.
It was gentle, yet unwavering—a smile of someone who had resolved to willingly embrace destiny.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As long as these feelings remain, surely—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: Bright will be fine, don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I answered with full confidence.
This time, too, she'll definitely make it in time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I shall be quite alright~.
So everyone, please treat me
well~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I will devote myself wholeheartedly, so please,
share your radiance with me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Bright... All riiiight!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the special training began.
A five-person intensive regimen under my guidance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*... Ughhh~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Bright, is that the best
your legs and hips have to offer?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Deeper, even deeper!
Know that a shallow step reflects a shallow resolve."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SWOOOSH!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Bright... not yet! Run with your whole body!
Don't just move your legs!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Coordinate your entire body
and drive all your power into the ground!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aalllrighty, I'll teach ya the secret to my explosive runaway lead!
...Not that I actually can, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I can substitute for Suzuka-chan.
Bright, let's train together. Chase after me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Lady Palmer~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*... Khh~,
*cough, cough*...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Bright... you told me before, remember?
That I'm not a burden anymore.
That we should do our best for our beloved Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So... let's do this. I'll stick with you all the way.
Because fellow Mejiros of the same generation
share both the joys and the falls.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes... Dober...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so they gallop along the beach in single file: Ryan, McQueen, Palmer, Dober, and bringing up the rear, Bright. It is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The Chronicles of the Mejiros. It was the very history of the Mejiro family, continuing on into the future.
